name: CSConDa
description: CSConDa is a high-quality benchmark dataset of over 9,000 QA pairs curated from real customer support conversations in Vietnamese. It evaluates Vietnamese large language models (ViLLMs) on domain-specific customer service tasks, covering diverse topics such as pricing, product availability, and technical troubleshooting, with a comprehensive evaluation framework including automatic metrics and syntactic analysis.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for Vietnamese customer-support QA, mainly adopted in research on Vietnamese LLMs and domain adaptation.
notes: Dataset is publicly available on Hugging Face; focuses on Vietnamese customer support domain.
